suites.notes: 65 tests at commit 56bfcf2 on Node 24.11.1 / Windows. The 2 failures are in scenarios.test.mjs ('the shipped scenario file matches its manifest' and 'refuses a modified file unless told otherwise'): the Windows checkout (core.autocrlf=true) turns eval/scenarios.jsonl into CRLF, so its sha256 differs from the frozen manifest; `git show HEAD:...scenarios.jsonl | sha256sum` equals the manifest value, so the committed file is intact. Environment artifact, not a tool defect; not fixed in this run.
